newsitem.title: USA: Dell cuts prices up to 16 pct on OptiPlex.
newsitem.headline: Dell cuts prices up to 16 pct on OptiPlex.

text.p: Dell Computer Corp said Wednesday it has cut prices again on its line of network-ready Dell OptiPlex corporate desktop PCs.

Today's reductions of up to 16 percent are effective immediately, the company said. The company said it is the fourth price cut announcement this year on OptiPlex PCs, with prices on some systems having dropped as much as 50 percent since January.

It said the biggest cuts are on configurations for Microsoft Windows 95 and Windows NT Workstation 4.0. The company said many of these systems now are already priced up to 34 percent less than comparable systems offered by competitors.
